candidate.derivedAnswer: A. C and r are variables; 2π is a constant
candidate.answerReason: Changing the radius changes the circumference, while the numerical coefficient \(2\pi\) stays fixed.

methods.label: Identify changing and fixed quantities
methods.explanation: As the radius \(r\) changes, the circumference \(C\) changes with it, so both are variables. The value of \(2\pi\) remains unchanged, so it is a constant.
